title: Conditional activation steering with factorized condition and behavior Views
hypothesis: On two frozen synthetic contextual-activation worlds with 16 condition classes and 8 reusable behaviors, a rank-4 factorized condition/behavior Mirror will preserve conditional outputs (event recall >=0.95, conditional behavior accuracy >=0.95), hold hard-negative false-trigger rate <=0.01, and use <=0.65x actual serialized bytes of explicit CAST condition and behavior vectors.
physical_object: A frozen 64-dimensional identity activation map, condition-prototype bank and eight behavior-addition vectors.
mirror_coordinate: A condition code and a behavior code over separately learned shared orthonormal bases; a condition-to-behavior address table selects the behavior View when the condition score clears a calibrated gate.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen context-conditional functions composed from sixteen condition addresses and eight reusable behavior vectors; only directly measured condition IDs count.
controls: Explicit CAST-style condition prototypes plus behavior vectors with cosine-similarity gating
Native PCA/SVD compression of the same condition and behavior banks, with codes and calibrated gate
Independent condition-behavior action vectors as a storage/quality upper control

task.type: synthetic frozen contextual-activation steering mechanism screen
task.construction: Condition means lie in a random four-dimensional orthonormal subspace with a small private component. Each behavior addition lies in an independent four-dimensional orthonormal subspace. Hard negatives are midpoint mixtures of distinct nearby condition means plus activation noise and have no target behavior. Eight behavior vectors are assigned cyclically to sixteen conditions.
primary_metrics: hard-negative false-trigger rate at threshold calibrated to <=1% on a separate calibration set

development.selection: Report full frozen rank grid. Primary point is condition rank 4 and behavior rank 4. Gate is chosen independently per method using only calibration examples: lowest score threshold with calibration FPR <=0.01.
development.hyperparameter_changes_after_run: Prohibited without numbered amendment; source and tests must be frozen first.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if the primary rank-4 point passes every false-trigger, recall, behavior-accuracy and actual-byte gate and beats native PCA in function, bytes or compute by at least 10% at equal quality.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: condition/behavior prototypes or bases and codes
storage.common_frozen_identity_activation_map: parameter-free identity and excluded from incremental payload; same for all methods

compute.active_operation_proxy: CAST cosine score uses conditions*dimension products per input; low-rank gate uses dimension*condition_rank + conditions*condition_rank, plus dimension*behavior_rank decode and one dimension-sized addition; action gathering and shared bookkeeping reported separately.
compute.isolated_wall_clock: single process, NumPy CPU, fixed five-thread limit; report per-method fit and inference wall time

gates.PROMISING: At condition rank 4 and behavior rank 4 in both dev seeds, test FPR <=0.01, recall >=0.95, conditional behavior accuracy >=0.95 and payload <=0.65x CAST; also native PCA must fail to match the Mirror result by at least 10% on a useful quality/storage/compute dimension at equal quality.
gates.FAIL: Frozen conditional-quality/byte gate fails, or native PCA/CAST/ordinary shared gate exactly explains the Mirror result with no >=10% useful margin.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: A control cannot be fit/replayed or serialized inference outputs fail deterministic replay.

boundaries: This is a synthetic activation mechanism screen, not a language-model or semantic CAST reproduction. No claim about prompt meaning, safety, natural false triggers or user preference is allowed.
Condition and behavior supports are matched across methods; calibration examples are disjoint from evaluation examples.
A condition-behavior combination count is not independent capacity; only measured event behavior, errors and actual bytes count.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless all gates and a useful Mirror-specific margin pass.
